definitions.CtS-AI: U6tau as deployed (realised-cost controller + boost), 200 reps of the exact full-unit simulation per seed
definitions.content_recall: P(at least one content-bearing unit of the incident retained whole), averaged over the stratum's incidents (expected value for randomised policies; seeds averaged per incident)
definitions.groups: LP-IoT23 1% = the 6 LOSO folds at target p = 1% (realised 0.41-1.05%); LP-IoT23 0.1%; LP-IoT23 5% = 7-1 (4.96%); LP-Edge = realised 0.10/0.97/3.25%; incidents pooled over the group's streams
definitions.k: content-bearing (malicious payload) units of the incident; strata k<=20, 21-100, >100
definitions.presence_recall: P(any byte of a payload unit of the incident's metadata-defined set A = its device(s) x [first, last epoch] retained), same averaging
definitions.rel_bias/rel_rmse: natural estimator per evaluated estimand (>= 50 eligible units, Q > 0): bias/Q and RMSE/Q, median over (stream, estimand); B6 on D estimands only; B15 not scored
definitions.tte: per incident the median time to evidence (first retained content unit) in epochs after its first epoch; median over incidents; inf if not reached with probability 1/2
